_description: GoldFlow Phase 5 Experimental SMC Multi-Timeframe Strategy Configuration. Evaluates H4/H1 trend alignment filtering on lower-timeframe SMC v1 candidates.

strategy_rules.base_setup: Liquidity Sweep => Opposite CHoCH => Order-Block Retest/Rejection (identical to SMC v1 frozen)

mtf_filter.rule: Both H4 and H1 completed structure trends must agree with candidate direction
mtf_filter.candle_close_availability: Structure breaks available only at candle open + timeframe duration (strictly closed candles)
mtf_filter.conflict_policy: Reject candidate if H4 and H1 directions disagree or either is neutral

execution_costs.source: Captured defaults from initial MT5 live-audit fixture
